en.summary: Smart Assistant now floats over your work and answers more questions, offline.
items: A floating Smart Assistant you can move, resize and close; open it again from the header.
Clear answers about your marks, ranks and improvement, with numbers taken from SSR itself.
Asks which examination you mean when it is not clear; report-form and stream questions are answered directly.
Signed knowledge updates from the owner can be added safely; nothing is sent over the internet.

sw.summary: Msaidizi Mahiri sasa anaelea juu ya kazi yako na anajibu maswali zaidi, bila intaneti.
items: Msaidizi Mahiri anayeelea ambaye unaweza kumhamisha, kumbadilisha ukubwa na kumfunga; mfungue tena kutoka juu.
Majibu wazi kuhusu alama, nafasi na kuboresha, na namba zinatoka ndani ya SSR yenyewe.
Anauliza ni mtihani gani unaomaanisha pale isipokuwa wazi; maswali ya fomu za ripoti na mikondo hujibiwa moja kwa moja.
Masasisho ya maarifa yaliyosainiwa na mmiliki yanaweza kuongezwa kwa usalama; hakuna kinachotumwa kwenye intaneti.
